name: Druid - Grove Architect
description: Transforming the Druid into a master of battlefield geography. By dynamically generating physical collision geometry and Line of Sight (LoS) blockers, you can completely rewrite the physical arena and manipulate the ecosystem to trap, damage, or heal.

bonuses.text: Allies standing inside an Ash Patch gain 15% increased haste.

items.name: Seed of the Bramble Wall
items.stats:
+140 Intellect
+100 Haste
Equip: Alters Entangling Roots to spawn a targeted Bramble Wall composed of physical collision and LoS-blocking geometry.
items.flavor: An aggressive, fast-growing strain of ironwood.

origin.details: Drops from an overgrowth monstrosity in a mid-tier nature dungeon.

catalyst.details: Cultivate the seed with enchanted water and fortified soil to awaken its rapid-growth properties.

items.name: Mantle of the Ecosystem
items.stats:
+130 Intellect
+115 Mastery
Equip: Casting Hurricane or Tranquility on a Bramble Wall mutates it into a damage-dealing Lasher-Bramble or a restorative Blooming-Bramble.
items.flavor: Life adapts to the weather it is given.

origin.details: A rare drop from an elite ancient in an endgame forested zone.

catalyst.details: Weave living vines into the mantle and infuse it with nature magic to restore its vitality.

items.name: Staff of the Controlled Burn
items.stats:
+195 Intellect
+140 Critical Strike
Equip: Casting Moonfire on a Bramble Wall incinerates it, instantly removing LoS blockers, dealing burst damage, and leaving an Ash Patch that grants movement speed and resource regeneration.
items.flavor: Destruction is just the first step of cultivation.

origin.details: Raid boss drop from a corrupted fiery treant.

catalyst.details: Carve druidic runes into the charred wood and bind a core of living flame to control the incineration.
